title: vNext Workflow Definition
description: Schema for vNext Workflow Component Definition JSON files (sys-flows flow)

executionType.description: Optional default execution mode for this flow (vnext#1003). Applies to its transitions unless a transition overrides it with its own executionType (the inner definition wins).

history.description: Optional history mode (vnext#1006). 'none' marks a one-shot flow: the runtime writes no InstanceTransitions / InstanceTasks rows and a single buffered InstancesData row (written at Finish, at a SubFlow handoff or on a fault). Omitted or 'full' keeps full history. With 'none' the flow must be all-automatic and always finish; this schema enforces the shape rules below, while the runtime also rejects at publish states that cannot reach a Finish state (cycles, dead ends) and, at start, a SubFlow child that is not itself 'none'.

sharedTransitions.description: Shared transitions available across multiple states

errorBoundary.description: Global error boundary for the workflow. Applied when no task or state-level boundary handles the error.

cancel.description: Cancel transition definition. Only manual trigger (triggerType: 0) is allowed.

exit.description: Exit transition definition. Only manual trigger (triggerType: 0) is allowed.

updateData.description: Update  data transition definition. Only manual trigger (triggerType: 0) is allowed.

states.description: States in the workflow. At most one initial state (stateType: 1) may be declared. When none is declared the runtime's implicit '$start' state is the start transition's source.

schema.description: Master schema definition for the workflow to validate the data

queryRoles.description: Root-level query roles for instance access. Used when state has no queryRoles. DENY overrides ALLOW.

output.description: Optional output mapping for the workflow. Based on ScriptCode definition.

event.description: Optional workflow-level event definition. When present, an external event may start a new instance of this workflow (action=start). Independent of any transition-level event.

config.description: Optional flow-level configuration container (currently function cache tuning). Null means host defaults apply.

rowSecurity.description: Row security for instance list and GET queries. The caller's roles are matched against rules[].roles; the filters of every matching rule are OR-ed, and the result is AND-ed into the query. A static-role rule without a filter grants all rows. An identity rule ($InstanceStarter / $InstanceBehalfOfStarter) never grants all rows: it adds the caller's own instances (createdBy = the caller's ActorUserName / createdByBehalfOf = the caller's UserName), narrowed by its filter when one is given, and is ORed with the static rules. There is no default member: a flow that declares rowSecurity is deny by default, so a caller matching no rule sees no rows. Absent = no row filtering.

rules.description: Role-keyed row rules. Evaluated for the calling user; no match means no rows.

rowSecurityRule.description: One row rule: the roles it applies to and an optional row filter.

roles.description: Role names this rule applies to. Static role names, or the reserved $InstanceStarter / $InstanceBehalfOfStarter (validated by the runtime).

filter.description: Instance filter (same language as instance queries, e.g. { "attributes": { "branchCode": { "eq": "$.context.Headers.x-branch-code" } } }). Omitted = all rows for a static-role rule; for $InstanceStarter / $InstanceBehalfOfStarter it means all of the caller's own instances. String values or { "$param": ... } objects may reference $.context.Headers.* (gateway-written claim headers), $.context.QueryParameters.* (client-controlled: do not use for security decisions) or $.context.CurrentUser.{ActorUserName,ActorUserId,UserName,Position}. Structural only here; the runtime publish check is authoritative for operators and parameters.

rowSecurityParam.description: A filter parameter reference: { "$param": "$.context.Headers.x-branches", "split": "," }. $param must be a $.context. path; split turns the string value into a list (for in).

resourceLockDefinition.description: Defines a distributed resource-lock operation to be executed during a transition. The keyExpression is compiled as an ITransitionMapping and evaluated at runtime to produce the lock key.

keyExpression.description: Script compiled as ITransitionMapping whose handler returns the lock key string.

enumDescriptions: Acquires a distributed lock on the resource. Fails the transition if the resource is already locked by another owner.
Releases a previously acquired distributed lock on the resource.
Extends the TTL of an existing lock held by the same owner.

ttlSeconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds for Acquire and Extend operations. Acts as a safety net so abandoned locks expire automatically.

enumDescriptions: Abort the transition immediately when the lock cannot be acquired.
onConflict.description: Policy applied when the lock cannot be acquired (e.g., resource already locked).

workflowConfig.description: Flow-level configuration container. Consolidates author-controlled, workflow-scoped settings under a single config object. Null means host defaults apply.

functionCache.description: Optional author-controlled cache tuning for the built-in instance functions (data, view, schema, ...). Null means host defaults apply.

functionCacheDefinition.description: Workflow-author-controlled cache tuning for the built-in instance functions (data, view, schema, ...). A single TTL covers all of them.

ttlSeconds.description: Cache TTL in seconds for this workflow's built-in function responses. Null or non-positive falls back to the host default (InstanceFunctionCache:DefaultTtlSeconds).

roleGrantCondition.description: One role in an allOf/anyOf list: only a role name, a predefined instance role (including $Everyone) or a dynamic expression. No grant and no nesting (depth 1).

role.description: Role name (current: Amorphie roles; future: domain.rolename)

roleGrant.description: Single role grant. Used in roles/queryRoles arrays for allow/deny. DENY always overrides ALLOW. Exactly one of role, allOf (all listed roles required) or anyOf (at least one listed role) selects who the grant applies to.

role.description: Role name (current: Amorphie roles; future: domain.rolename)

allOf.description: Conjunction: the caller must hold every listed role.

anyOf.description: Disjunction: the caller must hold at least one listed role.

state.description: State key this entry applies to

roles.description: Role grants that apply only while the instance is in this state. Composed with the transition's own roles as an AND: both must allow. Omit or leave empty for no additional narrowing (identical to the bare string form).

availableIn.description: States where this transition is available, independent of trigger type. Null, empty or absent means every state. Each array item is either a bare state key or an object narrowing that state to a set of role grants; the two forms may be mixed.

executionType.description: Execution mode of a flow or transition (vnext#1003). S: synchronous — the request blocks until the pipeline settles and returns the full instance. A: asynchronous — the request is accepted and the pipeline runs in the background. Optional and non-breaking — when omitted, the caller's `sync` query parameter chooses the mode. When set it is the source of truth and overrides the query parameter; a transition's value (inner) wins over the flow's (outer). Not honoured for automatic transitions, which always run inline.
enumDescriptions: Synchronous — the request blocks and returns the full instance
Asynchronous — the request is accepted and runs in the background

historyMode.description: History mode of a flow (vnext#1006). none: one-shot flow without transition/task history and a single buffered data write; full: every data version, transition and task journal row is persisted. Omitted = full.
enumDescriptions: One-shot flow — no transition/task history, one buffered data write

triggerType.description: Type of trigger for the transition

triggerKind.description: Kind of trigger for automatic transitions

enumDescriptions: AI Agent state (experimental): runs a sys-agents component on entry and lets it pick one of the state's automatic transitions

language.description: Language code (ISO 639-1 with optional region code: en, en-US, tr, tr-TR)

reference.description: Generic reference - can be either explicit reference or ref

event.description: Event mapping for the event-workflow feature. The referenced mapping script (implements IEventMapping) turns the raw external event payload into an InstanceKey + Body.

code.description: Script code content (string), or a sys-mappings reference when encoding is REF.

scripts.description: Helper script references and allowed assemblies for mapping execution.

allowedAssemblies.description: Allowed .NET assemblies for the script execution context.

viewOverrides.description: Dictionary of view overrides for subflow views. Key is the original view key, value is the reference to the new view definition. Deprecated: use overrides.states.<state>.views / overrides.transitions.<transition>.views.

overrides.description: Unified override configuration (views, transition roles, state query roles, timeout). Use instead of or alongside legacy viewOverrides.

subFlow.description: Information about the sub-workflow to be called for SubFlow state type. Can be null if developer does not have a subflow definition.

variableKey.description: Optional name of this entry's response slot in ScriptContext.TaskResponse / OutputResponse. Defaults to the task key converted to a variable name (e.g. 'send-notification' -> 'sendNotification'). Required in practice when the same task runs twice at the same order: entries at one order run in parallel and must file under distinct slots.

errorBoundary.description: Task-level error boundary. Provides the most specific error handling for this task.

description.description: Optional free-text description of when this transition applies. On an AiAgent state (stateType 6) it is the "when" text the agent sees for a candidate transition, after decision.hintsMapping and decision.hints. Never evaluated as a rule.

target.description: Target state key. Can be a state key or special keyword like $self

from.description: Source state key (optional for shared transitions)

priority.description: Evaluation priority among the state's automatic transitions. Lower values are evaluated first; the first satisfied rule wins. Omitted means 100. Equal values keep declaration order. The DefaultAutoTransition (triggerKind 10) is always evaluated last and cannot carry a priority. Only valid on state-level automatic transitions.

timer.description: Timer information if the transition should execute automatically

roles.description: Transition roles for authorization. DENY overrides ALLOW; default DENY when no match.

event.description: Optional transition-level event definition. When present, this transition can also be triggered by an external event (action=transition). Required when triggerType is Event (3).

resourceLock.description: Optional distributed resource-lock operation executed during this transition. Valid only for start, state-level, and shared transitions.

description.description: Optional free-text description of when this transition applies. On an AiAgent state (stateType 6) it is the "when" text the agent sees for a candidate transition, after decision.hintsMapping and decision.hints. Never evaluated as a rule.

target.description: Target state key. Can be a state key or special keyword like $self

from.description: Source state key (optional for shared transitions)

triggerType.description: Trigger type for shared transitions: Manual (0), Scheduled (2), Event (3)

roles.description: Transition roles for authorization. DENY overrides ALLOW; default DENY when no match.

timer.description: Timer information if the transition should execute automatically

event.description: Optional transition-level event definition. When present, this shared transition can also be triggered by an external event (action=transition). Required when triggerType is Event (3).

resourceLock.description: Optional distributed resource-lock operation executed during this transition. Valid only for start, state-level, and shared transitions.

allOf.description: priority orders a state's automatic transitions; a shared transition is never automatic.

description.description: Optional free-text description of when this transition applies. On an AiAgent state (stateType 6) it is the "when" text the agent sees for a candidate transition, after decision.hintsMapping and decision.hints. Never evaluated as a rule.

target.description: Required. Key of the state the instance enters when it starts; must equal the key of a state declared in 'states' (checked by the runtime at publish). Reserved keys such as '$start' and '$self' are not allowed.

triggerType.description: Start transition must be manual trigger only

roles.description: Transition roles for authorization. DENY overrides ALLOW; default DENY when no match.

resourceLock.description: Optional distributed resource-lock operation executed during this transition. Valid only for start, state-level, and shared transitions.

description.description: Optional free-text description of when this transition applies. On an AiAgent state (stateType 6) it is the "when" text the agent sees for a candidate transition, after decision.hintsMapping and decision.hints. Never evaluated as a rule.

target.description: Target state key when cancel is executed

triggerType.description: Cancel transition must be manual trigger only

schema.description: Data schema reference that must be sent to execute the cancel transition

onExecutionTasks.description: Tasks to execute during cancel transition

mapping.description: Optional mapping definition for cancel transition input data transformation

roles.description: Transition roles for authorization. DENY overrides ALLOW; default DENY when no match.

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for the cancel transition

description.description: Optional free-text description of when this transition applies. On an AiAgent state (stateType 6) it is the "when" text the agent sees for a candidate transition, after decision.hintsMapping and decision.hints. Never evaluated as a rule.

target.description: Target state key when exit is executed

triggerType.description: Exit transition must be manual trigger only

schema.description: Data schema reference that must be sent to execute the exit transition

onExecutionTasks.description: Tasks to execute during exit transition

mapping.description: Optional mapping definition for exit transition input data transformation

roles.description: Transition roles for authorization. DENY overrides ALLOW; default DENY when no match.

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for the exit transition

_comment.description: Comment about the update data transition

description.description: Optional free-text description of when this transition applies. On an AiAgent state (stateType 6) it is the "when" text the agent sees for a candidate transition, after decision.hintsMapping and decision.hints. Never evaluated as a rule.

target.description: Target state key when update data is executed (must be $self)

triggerType.description: update data transition must be manual trigger only

schema.description: Data schema reference that must be sent to execute the update data transition

onExecutionTasks.description: Tasks to execute during update data transition

mapping.description: Optional mapping definition for update data transition input data transformation

roles.description: Transition roles for authorization. DENY overrides ALLOW; default DENY when no match.

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for the update data transition

then.title: AI Agent state
then.description: An AiAgent state (stateType 6) must declare an agent block. Its sub type is None (0) or Busy (5) and it cannot run a subFlow. Candidate counts, reserved exits and hints keys are checked by the runtime at publish, not here.

agent.description: Only an AiAgent state (stateType 6) may declare an agent block.

onEntries.description: Tasks to execute when entering the state

onExits.description: Tasks to execute when exiting the state

errorBoundary.description: State-level error boundary. Applied when no task-level boundary handles the error.

queryRoles.description: State-level query roles for instance access. Overrides root queryRoles when present. DENY overrides ALLOW.

alias.description: Optional role-scoped aliases for the state. Each alias provides alternative multi-language labels for a state, shown to users matching the alias roles.

interaction.description: Optional state interaction configuration (e.g. long polling).

notifications.description: Notification definitions attached to this state.

agent.description: AI agent binding (experimental). Required on, and only allowed on, an AiAgent state (stateType 6).

agentStateBinding.description: The agent block of an AiAgent state: which sys-agents component runs, its prompt, where the structured output lands and how the next transition is chosen.

agent.description: The sys-agents component that runs (the lead agent when mode is not single).

enumDescriptions: The participants run in order, each seeing the outputs before it, then the lead produces the output and decision
The participants run in parallel on the same prompt, then the lead produces the output and decision
The lead runs as a router and names one participant, which produces the output and decision
mode.description: How several agents work in this state.

agents.description: Participants of a multi-agent state. Required (at least one) when mode is sequential, concurrent or handoff; not allowed when mode is single. Names must be unique in the state (checked by the runtime).

output.description: Where the structured output lands in instance data.

path.description: JSON path the output (plus the $agent run summary) is merged under, e.g. $.triage.

memory.description: Overrides the component's memory settings for this state.

exclude.description: Tool names hidden from the model in this state.

policy.description: Narrows the component's policy; a state can only lower its budgets.

agentParticipant.description: A participant agent of a multi-agent state.

name.description: Participant name, unique in the state; the lead sees outputs and routes by it.

agent.description: The sys-agents component of the participant.

description.description: What the lead is told this participant is for (handoff).

agentPrompt.description: The user prompt: an inline template with {{ data.* }}, {{ body.* }}, {{ instance.id }}, {{ instance.key }} and {{ state }} placeholders, or a C# IAgentPromptMapping (location + code).

location.description: Source file of the C# IAgentPromptMapping.

messages.description: Seed messages sent before the user prompt on every run (few-shot examples, extra instructions).

content.description: Message content; a template with the same placeholders as prompt.template.

context.description: Named data blocks appended to the user prompt as <data name="…">…</data>, so the model reads them as data and not as instructions. The value is a data., body. or instance. path.

agentDecision.description: How the next transition is chosen. Candidates are the state's automatic transitions without a rule, minus the reserved exits (fallback, onApprovalRequest, onExhausted) and exclude. The runtime checks at publish that every reserved exit is a rule-less automatic transition of the state, that model mode has at least two candidates, that rules mode has none, and that every hints key is a candidate.

enumDescriptions: The model chooses among the candidates (default)
The transitions' own rules choose over the agent's output

exclude.description: Automatic transitions left out of the candidate set.

hints.description: "When" texts per candidate transition key; they win over the transition description.

mapping.description: C# IAgentDecisionMapping; required when mode is script.

fallback.description: Automatic transition taken when the run cannot decide (failure, timeout, budget, non-candidate decision).

onApprovalRequest.description: Automatic transition taken when a tool asks for human approval; it may target any state. Without it the state takes its fallback.

onExhausted.description: Automatic transition taken when policy.maxEntries is reached.

agentMemory.description: Conversation memory settings. On a state they overlay the component's.

enumDescriptions: Per instance, shared by the flow's agent states
Across instances, keyed by the rendered memory.key

storage.description: Where the conversation lives: the runtime stores the messages (local) or the provider stores it and only its id is kept (provider).

maxMessages.description: Messages kept; the oldest are trimmed or summarized first.

compaction.description: How a local session is kept within maxMessages: drop the oldest messages (trim, default) or replace them with one model-written summary (summarize).

retentionDays.description: Days a session is kept after its last write. An instance session (mode state or flow) is also deleted when its instance completes or is cancelled; a key session is kept until it expires.

agentPolicy.description: Budgets and retry of an agent run. Values are also capped by the environment ceilings (checked by the runtime).

resultMaxChars.description: Tool result characters the model receives.

maxEntries.description: State entries before decision.onExhausted is taken.

onProviderError.description: After retries are exhausted: take the decision fallback, or fail the transition so the error boundary decides.

stateAlias.description: Role-scoped alias for a state, providing alternative multi-language labels for users matching the given roles.

roles.description: Roles for which this alias applies. DENY overrides ALLOW.

enumDescriptions: Abort (0) - Abort execution. Transition must not be set.
Retry (1) - Retry with configured retry policy. RetryPolicy is required.
Rollback (2) - Rollback to compensation state. Transition is required (transition key).
Notify (4) - Send notification and transition. Transition is required (transition key).
Log (5) - Log only, does not affect flow
errorAction.description: Action to take when an error is caught by an error boundary. Constraint: Abort → no transition; Retry → retryPolicy required; Rollback/Notify → transition required.

retryPolicy.description: Configures retry behavior for error handling. Required when error action is Retry. InitialDelay must be a positive duration; MaxDelay must be greater than or equal to InitialDelay. For BackoffType Exponential, backoffMultiplier must be greater than 0.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts (0 or greater; values above 100 are discouraged)

initialDelay.description: Initial delay before first retry (ISO 8601 duration). Must be greater than zero.

maxDelay.description: Maximum delay between retries (ISO 8601 duration). Must be greater than or equal to initialDelay.

useJitter.description: Whether to add random jitter to retry delays

errorHandlerRule.description: A single error handling rule within an error boundary

then.description: When action is Abort (0), transition must not be set (backend will reject non-empty transition).

errorTypes.description: Exception type names to match (e.g., ValidationException). Omit or use '*' to match all. Items must not be empty or whitespace.

errorCodes.description: Error codes to match (e.g., 'Task:400007', '500'). Omit or use '*' to match all. Items must not be empty or whitespace.

transition.description: Workflow transition key to trigger when this rule matches. Required when action is Notify or Rollback. Must not be set when action is Abort. Must reference a valid transition key (StartTransition, Cancel, SharedTransitions, or state transition key).

priority.description: Rule priority. Lower values evaluated first. Must be greater than 0. Default 100; use higher values (e.g. 999) for wildcard/fallback rules. Duplicate priorities are allowed but unique values are recommended for deterministic matching.

logOnly.description: If true, only logs the error without affecting execution flow

timeoutPolicy.description: Timeout-specific error handling policy. When action is Retry, defaultRetryPolicy is required. Transition must not be set when action is Abort. Transition must reference a valid workflow state key.

then.description: When action is Abort (0), transition must not be set (backend will reject non-empty transition).

transition.description: State key to transition to on timeout. Must match a workflow state key. Must not be set when action is Abort.

errorBoundary.description: Container for error handling policies. Used at workflow level (global), state level, and on task execution (OnExecuteTask, OnEntry, OnExit). OnError rules are evaluated by effective priority (lower first); duplicate priorities are discouraged. OnTimeout applies when the operation times out.

onError.description: Error handling rules evaluated in priority order (lower value first). Rule transition references workflow transition keys. Empty array is valid (no error rules).

mapping.description: Optional mapping script for dynamic timeout duration calculation. When provided, the script is executed at runtime to determine the timeout schedule. If the mapping fails, the static timer duration is used as fallback.

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for the timeout, surfaced on the state function's timeout block for client UI context. A subFlow.overrides.timeout replaces the child's timeout as a whole, annotations included.

subFlowLongPollOverride.description: Parent override of a child state's interaction.longPoll. Field-level: omitted fields keep the child's value. terminate and rule are not overridable.

roles.description: Replaces the child's long-poll role grants as a whole list. Empty admits every caller. Ignored when the child uses a rule.

subFlowTransitionOverride.description: Per-transition override configuration for a subflow. Replaces transition roles, view swaps.

roles.description: Transition role overrides. DENY always overrides ALLOW.

views.description: View swap for this child transition. Key is the view key the child's rules selected; value is the replacement view.

subFlowStateOverride.description: Per-state override configuration for a subflow: query roles (replace), long-poll (field-level), view swaps.

queryRoles.description: State query role overrides. DENY always overrides ALLOW.

interaction.description: Field-level override of the child state's interaction.

views.description: View swap for this child state. Key is the view key the child's rules selected; value is the replacement view.

subFlowOverrides.description: Unified override configuration for a subflow. All overrides use replace mode.

views.description: Dictionary of view overrides. Key is the original view key, value is the new view reference. Deprecated: use overrides.states.<state>.views / overrides.transitions.<transition>.views.

transitions.description: Dictionary of transition overrides. Key is the transition key.

states.description: Dictionary of state overrides. Key is the state key.

annotations.description: Key-value annotations (transitions and the workflow timeout). Pure passthrough metadata for client UI context; the runtime does not interpret values. Use namespaced keys, e.g. ui/priority.

longPoll.description: Long polling configuration for the state. The runtime keeps the request open until a transition occurs or the fallback timeout elapses. Authorization is exactly one of two mutually exclusive arms: role grants ('roles') or a condition rule ('rule') — never both.

terminate.description: Whether the long poll terminates the open request when the state is left.

fallbackTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum number of seconds to hold the request open before falling back.

roles.description: Roles allowed to use the long poll interaction. DENY overrides ALLOW. Mutually exclusive with 'rule'.

rule.description: Condition script (IConditionMapping, true/false) deciding per caller whether the interaction applies — the rule-based alternative to 'roles'. At most one rule per interaction. A false, throwing, or non-compiling rule denies (fail-closed) on both the state signal and the acknowledge endpoint.

stateNotification.description: Notification configuration attached to a state.

type.description: Notification type. Currently only State (0) is supported.
